objective: Test a representation-level address-value binding in which correct RWKV state is decoded in its write basis and a matched-donor state with a separated address code is decoded in the wrong basis.

bilinear_component_disjoint_crossfit.decision: The bilinear output-coupling route is the current winner. Rotary binding remains inactive unless that route fails its separately locked mechanics or causal endpoint.

learned_address_conditioned_write.interpretation: An additive or multiplicative address perturbation of k/v/a/b can be ignored and supplies no inverse read transform.

architecture.write: Rotate each two-coordinate pair of RWKV v by theta(write_address) before the recurrent state scan.
architecture.read: Apply the inverse rotation from theta(query_address) to the raw matrix read before HRM RWKV group normalization and output projection.
architecture.correct_address_property: The write and read rotations cancel algebraically inside each RWKV head.
architecture.matched_donor_property: A donor state carries donor-address rotations and is inversely rotated with the target address; the held-out code-separation gate prevents phase aliasing.

priority_relative_to_bilinear_infonce.current_winner: bilinear InfoNCE compatibility followed by the separately gated output-coupling route
priority_relative_to_bilinear_infonce.winner_evidence: The component-disjoint 176/44 cross-fit passed every held-out gate: donor fraction 0.954545, donor mean gap 0.118183, and layer-permuted fraction 1.0.
priority_relative_to_bilinear_infonce.fallback_activation: Only if the bilinear route fails its output-coupled mechanics or causal endpoint and its stopping rule returns the project to architectural alternatives.
priority_relative_to_bilinear_infonce.fallback_rationale: It moves identity into the stored value basis, but currently has only algebraic unit evidence, adds the same 512 parameters per layer as the bilinear head under the actual one-head width-32 adapter geometry, and requires two integration hooks.
priority_relative_to_bilinear_infonce.hybrid_policy: Do not combine the routes before each has independent causal evidence.

phase_1_future_mechanics_gate.authorization: Requires the current bilinear winner to fail a locked downstream gate and a separately finalized fallback protocol.
phase_1_future_mechanics_gate.data: Already-open fit rows only; no development generation rows and no protected split.
phase_1_future_mechanics_gate.failure: Retire the binding branch without causal training or generation.

phase_2_future_causal_gate.authorization: Only a signed phase-1 mechanics pass may authorize this phase.
phase_2_future_causal_gate.data: Source-and-donor-component-disjoint open-fit schedule and endpoint fixed before launch.
phase_2_future_causal_gate.phase_projection: Frozen after an address-only component-disjoint code-separation fit so answer CE cannot collapse all addresses to one phase.
phase_2_future_causal_gate.failure: Block generation; do not tune gain, batch size, or duration on the endpoint.

phase_3_future_native_benchmark_gate.authorization: Only a separately signed phase-2 causal pass may authorize a locked generation protocol.
phase_3_future_native_benchmark_gate.claim_rule: Passing supports native open-development memory gain only. It is not an official SOTA claim and does not authorize opening publisher validation/test, Hard32, or strength holdouts.
